facts.en: Completed an agricultural operations support certificate at Fictional Plumfurrow Institute in 2022.
facts.zh: 2022 年在虚构李垄学院完成农业运营支持证书课程。

facts.en: Paid seasonal packing assistant at Fictional Goldfinch Orchard from 2024-08 to 2024-11 and from 2025-08 to 2025-11.
facts.zh: 2024-08 至 2024-11 及 2025-08 至 2025-11 在虚构金翅雀果园任有薪季节性包装助理。

facts.en: Sorted harvested fruit using visual examples and grade labels supplied by the packing supervisor.
facts.zh: 依据包装主管提供的视觉示例及等级标签分拣采收水果。

facts.en: Set aside uncertain fruit for the supervisor rather than creating new grading rules.
facts.zh: 将难以确定的水果留给主管，而非制定新的分级规则。

facts.en: Counted filled crates by field-block reference and recorded the batch label before dispatch.
facts.zh: 按田块编号清点装满的筐，并在发运前记录批次标签。

facts.en: Prepared empty crates and set up collection points according to the team lead’s daily plan.
facts.zh: 依据团队负责人每日计划准备空筐，并布置收集点。

facts.en: A trained driver moved palletized loads; the candidate’s documented duties did not include forklift driving.
facts.zh: 由受训司机搬运托盘货物；候选人记录中的职责不含叉车驾驶。

facts.en: A 2025-09 packing log records 84 crates sent to the main dispatch area and 16 held for supervisor review from one 100-crate intake.
facts.zh: 一份 2025-09 包装日志记录，在一次 100 筐入库中，84 筐送至主要发运区，16 筐留待主管审核。

facts.en: The source does not state the eventual sale, regrading or disposal outcome of those 16 held crates.
facts.zh: 来源未说明这 16 筐暂留货物最终出售、重新分级或处置的结果。

facts.en: Crate weights were not recorded in that log, so it provides no total harvested mass.
facts.zh: 该日志未记录筐的重量，因此未提供采收总质量。

facts.en: Helped test a colour-and-text batch tag during 4 packing shifts in 2025-10.
facts.zh: 2025-10 在 4 个包装班次中协助测试结合颜色与文字的批次标签。

facts.en: Personally checked that the block code remained readable; the supervisor selected the grading colours.
facts.zh: 个人检查田块代码是否仍清晰可读；分级颜色由主管选择。

facts.en: Uses manual tally counters, batch tags and simple spreadsheet intake totals.
facts.zh: 使用手动计数器、批次标签及简单电子表格入库汇总。

facts.en: Completed the orchard’s seasonal packing induction at the start of each recorded season.
facts.zh: 在记录中的每个季节开始时完成果园季节性包装入职培训。

facts.en: Volunteered with Fictional Acornbasket Food Share from 2023-02 to 2024-05.
facts.zh: 2023-02 至 2024-05 在虚构橡果篮食物分享团体做志愿者。

facts.en: At that group, labeled donated produce boxes with dates supplied by the organizer and checked distribution-list counts.
facts.zh: 在该团体依据组织者提供的日期为捐赠农产品箱贴标签，并核对分发清单数量。

facts.en: The organizer decided food acceptance and distribution allocations; the candidate did not make those decisions.
facts.zh: 组织者决定食品接收及分发配额；候选人不作出这些决定。

facts.en: Created a personal illustrated orchard-season diary in 2025 with invented fruit-pattern drawings.
facts.zh: 2025 年使用虚构水果图案绘画制作个人图解果园季节日记。

facts.en: Enjoys weaving small decorative baskets from paper strips.
facts.zh: 爱好用纸条编织小型装饰篮。

facts.en: Recorded packing shifts started at 06:00 during the 2025 season.
facts.zh: 记录中的 2025 年季节性包装班次于 06:00 开始。

facts.en: Availability for 06:00 starts in the 2027 harvest season has not been confirmed.
facts.zh: 尚未确认能否在 2027 年采收季参加 06:00 开始的班次。
